commands: /Users/kietnt/miniconda3/bin/python experiments/ext/v51fix/preflight_p4h2.py   # must print PREFLIGHT PASS, exit 0
expected_runtime_workers3: run about 11 min (647 s for the same config on D-07 development, 2520 rows; 20 topologies in P4-H2 confirmatory as in D-07), up to about 20 min under heavy shared CPU load; preflight < 30 s; analyzer about 1 min
confirmatory_rule: tolerant_v5_1 is CONFIRMED on P4-H2 iff all hold. V (validity): manifest config equals the frozen config file; bank P4-H2 confirmatory, methods [tolerant_v4, tolerant_v5_1], a2 grid, seed_base 20261102, n_boot 199, H 4; 2 x n_topologies x 3 x 21 rows, one per (key, method); calibration.json equals the frozen factors; every ok row carries its frozen width factor (and prescale 0.5 for v5_1); every ok v5_1 row carries the fingerprint fields info_v51_targeted and info_v51_ratio. F (failures): failed tolerant_v5_1 runs <= 1% of its runs (12 of 1260) overall and <= 5% (3 of 60) in each of the 21 rule cells; a rule cell with 0 ok runs of either method fails its condition. C1: at T=40 missing-0.2 and missing-0.5, ITT coverage of v5_1 (failed runs count as covering none of their non-null pairs) >= 0.90 and the upper bound of the 95% CI (topology bootstrap, 1000, seed 0) of the paired IS difference (v5_1 - v4) < 0. C2: at T=80 and 150, all 12 damaged cells, ITT coverage of v5_1 >= 0.90 and mean IS of v5_1 <= 1.05 x mean IS of v4. C3: none at T=40/80/150 and extra/reversed x 0.2/0.5 at T=40 (7 cells): mean IS of v5_1 <= 1.05 x mean IS of v4. Reported, not the official verdict: C1 with Holm over 2 cells; C1 with Bonferroni over 2 (97.5% CI) and 3 (98.33% CI) primary specs; cells of C2/C3 where v5_1 is significantly worse after Holm; coverage-gated cells significantly below 0.90 after Holm; share of missing runs in the targeted branch (must be 100%: r <= (T-2)/29 <= 5.10 < 6.6083 at T <= 150 with 14 nodes).
notes: Method description for the paper: 'v5 with de-duplicated targeted lag opening, re-selected in every bootstrap draw'; the code's all-lag fallback (r >= 6.61, T >= 194 with 14 nodes) is never reachable on this grid; tau is fragile (11% of probe bootstrap seeds give 2.94) and is not claimed.
Bug E1 is not fixed: the tolerant_v4 rows of this run are the paper's P4-H2 v4 table; other P4-H2 configs with other cell lists give other v4 realisations; pair only within this config.
If the run is interrupted before runs.jsonl exists, it may be rerun once with the config unchanged (synthesis_round2 3.3); E1 in the preflight must then be read accordingly and the rerun disclosed.
